title: POAG and IOP GWAS two-sample Mendelian randomization
bodyHtml: This table contains two-sample Mendelian Randomization (MR) results for all e/sQTLs (QTL type-target gene-tissue combinations) that significantly colocalized with genome-wide significant primary open-angle glaucoma (POAG) cross-ancestry and European GWAS loci or intraocular pressure (IOP) loci, to provide additional genetic support for a causal relationship between the colocalizing e/sQTLs and POAG risk and/or IOP levels. MR was applied to the summary statistics of the European subset POAG GWAS meta-analysis only (Gharahkhani et al., Nat Commun 2021) and the IOP GWAS meta-analysis, which is primarily European (Khawaja et al., Nat Genet 2018) to avoid confounding by ancestry, as the e/sQTL studies are also primarily European. The primary MR test is the Wald ratio test. If multiple variants constitute the instrumental variables (IVs) for the e/sQTL target gene, the inverse-variance weighted (IVW) method was used to pool variant-specific estimates. For sensitivity analysis, the simple-median, weighted-median, MR-Egger, and MR-PRESSO methods were applied. Horizontal pleiotropy was tested for cases with ≥3 IVs, using the Egger-intercept test and MR-PRESSO global heterogeneity test ; P < 0.05 indicates presence of horizontal pleiotropy. The table was taken from Supplementary Data 29 in Hamel et al., 2024.
